title: Console UX diffusion launch playbook and localized training
creator: Maya Chen
description: Run a staged launch for the new Console UX feature set (interactive dashboards, rollout controls, and tokenized cost breakdowns) with a special emphasis on localized training for EU/APAC customers and a narrow beta to validate guidance and materials. Produce a playbook that ties release notes, localized materials, customer-facing comms, and cross-team dry-runs into an executable schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Final release notes published and localized into en, fr, de, ja
Training sessions scheduled and recorded for EMEA/APAC windows with role-specific tracks (engineer, CS, solutions)
Beta cohort of at least 10 customers onboarded and feedback captured via structured evals
Launch playbook signed off by PM, Design, Eng, Growth, and Support
Console feature flags implemented for staged rollouts and canary metrics instrumented
tasks: Draft canonical release notes and a 2-paragraph product summary for marketing
Coordinate with Design for screenshot and video assets (localized variants)
Work with Engineering to confirm rollout flag gating and monitoring endpoints
Create instructor slide deck and 10-minute demo videos per role
Set up a beta group in the Console (beta toggle + opt-in email flow)
Align Support runbook with known issues and escalation paths
Schedule two cross-functional dry runs and one executive readout
stakeholders: Evan Brooks — Eng owner (rollout flags & metrics)
rollout_plan: Week -3: Publish internal playbook and distribute draft release notes to stakeholders
Week -2: Record demo videos; localizers begin translations; beta cohort recruitment starts
Week -1: Cross-functional dry run 1 (internal), finalize support runbook and FAQs
Launch Day: Open beta to cohort; enable feature flag for 5% of production requests in NA
Launch+2d: Increase to 25% in NA; enable 10% EMEA; monitor latency, error rate, and cost delta
Launch+7d: Expand to 100% for NA; 50% EMEA/APAC depending on metrics; commence broader comms
Post-launch Week 2: Retrospective, roll forward full GA if stability targets met
training_plan: Role-based curriculum: three tracks (Engineers, Solutions, Support) — slides + 10-min demo + 30-min Q&A
Localization windows: EMEA sessions scheduled between 08:00–12:00 UTC; APAC sessions 00:00–04:00 UTC (local times for trainers)
Recording and async hub: all sessions uploaded to Drive with timestamped chapters and downloadable assets
Trainer checklist: test demo tenant, verify feature flag visibility, rehearse failover script
Measurement: post-training survey (NPS-style) and short knowledge check (5 questions)
comms_plan: Customer-facing release note email for beta cohort with opt-in instructions
Public release note page updated at GA with screenshots and 'How to' quickstart
Feature spotlight blog post timed with GA including cost breakdown examples
Internal Slack channels: #console-launch and #support-runbooks with pinned assets
Sales enablement: one-pager and suggested scripts for demo calls (localized)
risks: Localization lag: translations not ready by launch window
Unexpected cost regressions for long-sequence workloads affecting trust in cost breakdowns
Rollout flag misconfiguration could expose incomplete UI to users
Support bandwidth during first 72 hours may be insufficient for simultaneous regional rollouts
